case.summary: Case CASE-009 (Card SC-03009-K955): The investigation was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.48 on transaction 4012185 ($14.50), flagged as a coordinated micro-payment ring [EV-0ec71b8d]. The flagged card SC-03009-K955 showed 4 online transactions within 48 hours and a historical average of $3.00 across 3 prior transactions [EV-6db89be6, EV-2e64af3d]. Device fingerprint analysis revealed the same device profile shared across 17 other cards, including 5 explicitly named (SC-09000-K1 through SC-09004-K2) and 10 linked to this case [EV-74a90e3d]. Fraud-ring analysis confirmed 4 fraud-confirmed cards within the device component, with a ring size of 18 [EV-5dcd914f]. The customer denied making the purchases and confirmed physical card possession [EV-6e807dc0]. Prior history includes one cleared legitimate case for this customer [EV-de456c89] and five prior closed cases matching the card_testing pattern [EV-660eadb3].

sar.narrative: A Suspicious Activity Report is warranted for CASE-009 based on evidence of a coordinated micro-payment fraud ring. The real-time model scored transaction 4012185 at 0.48 risk, identifying a micro-payment pattern across four transactions totaling $23.51 in exposure [EV-0ec71b8d]. Device fingerprint analysis linked the activity to a shared device profile across 17 cards, with 10 cards directly connected to this case and 4 confirmed fraud cards within the device component (ring size 18) [EV-74a90e3d, EV-5dcd914f]. The affected card SC-03009-K955 exhibited anomalous velocity with 4 online transactions in 48 hours, deviating from its historical $3.00 average [EV-6db89be6, EV-2e64af3d]. The customer reported no authorization of the transactions and confirmed physical card possession, supporting card-not-present fraud [EV-6e807dc0]. Prior case retrieval shows a pattern consistent with card_testing across five similar closed cases [EV-660eadb3], while one prior case for this customer was cleared as legitimate [EV-de456c89]. The undocumented pattern designation and 0.775 fraud probability further support the fraud verdict. This activity exhibits hallmarks of organized card-testing and micro-laundering through a shared device infrastructure.
